name: Amonkhet
description: Amonkhet is a desert plane of dichotomy, with a lush river valley and glorious city ringed by scorching desert, ruled by animal-headed gods and a God-Pharaoh who was Nicol Bolas ruling in absentia.

description_citations.text: "Amonkhet". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary.text: Amonkhet is a desert plane of dichotomy, with a lush river valley and glorious city ringed by scorching desert, ruled by animal-headed gods and a God-Pharaoh who was Nicol Bolas ruling in absentia.

citations.text: "Amonkhet". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

bio.text: Its people train their bodies and minds and eagerly anticipate being permitted to die in combat.

citations.text: "Amonkhet". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Liliana and Jace both believed Nicol Bolas created the plane, and Bolas rules it in absentia as God-Pharaoh.

citations.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.
"Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.
"Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

bio.text: The city of Naktamun lies on Amonkhet, and the corrupted leylines of the world form the essence of the god Kefnet.

citations.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.
"The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

bio.text: Jace later showed Vraska his memory of breaking into Bolas's mind on Amonkhet.

citations.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

bio.text: Years later, Amonkheti racers took part in the Aetherdrift race, with Basri and Zahur among the Champions, and Basri protecting civilians from a dragon's heat with sand that turned to glass.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.
"Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

bio.text: The Amonkheti team crossed the finish line first and received the Aetherspark together as a team.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.
"Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

status.text: The latest event in the material shows the Amonkheti Champions winning the Aetherdrift race and receiving the Aetherspark together as a team.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess kills the demon Razaketh.
timeline.quote: Liliana Vess kills the demon Razaketh .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch confronts Nicol Bolas and is soundly defeated.
timeline.quote: When the Gatewatch confronts Nicol Bolas , they are soundly defeated.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Munhatep interrupts the party at the pyramid, demands Temmet's body, and takes it.
timeline.quote: Munhatep removed Temmet's body and prepared to retreat

citation.text: "Temmet", section "2 nd Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ketramose arrives, tosses Munhatep aside, and revives Temmet, declaring that he will serve Ketramose.
timeline.quote: The god proceeded to revive Temmet, freeing him from the charred lazotep

citation.text: "Temmet", section "2 nd Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A stable Omenpath from Amonkhet opens, making Muraganda's wilds part of the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: a stable Omenpath from Amonkhet opened up on Muraganda

citation.text: "Muraganda", section "Second Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch's five planeswalkers appear in the middle of an Amonkhet sandstorm.
timeline.quote: Five figures stood where none were moments ago, caught by surprise in the blinding sands.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Chandra melts sand into a glass dome to shelter the group from the storm.
timeline.quote: I step forward and shape the still-liquid glass into a simple, crude dome.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she knows little of where Bolas is; Nissa senses the plane's leylines are weak, and Chandra spots Bolas's horns on the horizon.
timeline.quote: the massive shadow of two horns pierces the sky

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa senses Amonkhet's life magic is dominated by death.
timeline.quote: the shadow of death dominated all I could reach, as if the world itself favored the silence of the dead.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Undead burst from the sand and grab Jace; the group fights a horde while Liliana commands undead to obey, assist and flee.
timeline.quote: rotting hands burst forth from the sand, grabbed Jace by the legs, and pulled him under.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Giant sand wurms erupt, and one swallows Liliana whole.
timeline.quote: I watched in horror she disappeared into the gullet of an enormous wurm.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, buried under undead, is rescued by Nissa and the two fight toward Chandra.
timeline.quote: Suddenly the limbs of the zombie holding my right arm were no longer attached to its torso.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace's illusion lures a wurm away and Liliana emerges from a dying wurm, wreathed in the Chain Veil's purple light, then collapses.
timeline.quote: I watch, horrified, as Liliana steps forward out of the wurm

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills one wurm from the inside and is flung by another; Jace proposes retreating to Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: I ran forward and leaped into its open maw

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa kills a wurm by driving her sword into its skull.
timeline.quote: she drove her sword with both hands down, piercing its skull with a squish

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: A dead wurm reanimates, strikes Chandra and Jace, and Nissa senses the world is under an ancient curse inverting life and death.
timeline.quote: This world suffered an ancient, powerful curse.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Two zombified wurms attack; one coils around Nissa while Liliana lies in danger, forcing Gideon to choose.
timeline.quote: I stood, suspended, for a fraction of a second, fully aware that not making a choice meant choosing death for them both.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: A blazing white arrow kills the wurm over Liliana and a towering jackal-headed figure destroys the others and saves the group.
timeline.quote: She towered above me, standing at the height of a dozen men, golden headdress gleaming in the sun

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes there are gods on Amonkhet, in the world of Bolas.
timeline.quote: There are gods on Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, ruminating on whether the gods are Bolas's agents or his opponents, trudges through the desert with the group.
timeline.quote: To see gods wading amidst the horrors of the desert had not been among them.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana lounges in a shaded tent, served by mummies, thinking of her hunt for Razaketh and of Nicol Bolas, who brokered her demonic contracts.
timeline.quote: Razaketh would make three.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man appears and chides Liliana for sending shades to search rather than looking herself, and presses her to stay focused on her demon.
timeline.quote: One of your demons is in reach, and time is running out.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man reveals that he took command of the Chain Veil to blast Liliana out of the wurm's belly when she arrived on Amonkhet, which she did not know.
timeline.quote: Didn't I take command of the Chain Veil to blast you out of that wurm's belly when you arrived here?

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana warns the Raven Man to vanish as Jace approaches, and he disappears indignantly.
timeline.quote: "Don't forget why you're here," he said, and vanished indignantly.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace finds Liliana at her tent and they discuss the strange mummies and ambient necromancy of the city.
timeline.quote: it's possible they were raised by some kind of ambient necromancy.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: A shade reports it has found something, and Liliana leads Jace through the city, noticing that all the mummies are maimed.
timeline.quote: Have you noticed that all the mummies in the city are maimed?

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The shade stops at a wall of inscriptions bearing Razaketh's name, which makes Liliana sway.
timeline.quote: The inscription swam in her vision, and whispers pawed at the edges of her awareness.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Jace flee the embalming chamber; Liliana says Razaketh knows she is here and only the Chain Veil stops him activating her contract, and Jace admits Temmet will remember what he saw.
timeline.quote: Chain Veil's the only reason he can't . . . activate my contract.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana decides she needs the others and runs from her demon toward help.
timeline.quote: She ran, away from her demon, toward help.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa wanders the beautiful, empty city and uses her mana sense to perceive the dark strain strangling Amonkhet's leylines.
timeline.quote: A dark virulent strain wove its way through the leylines.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch is surprised to find perfection on a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: The one thing the Gatewatch didn't expect to find on a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas was perfection.

citation.text: Open into Wonder (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Djeru shows a cursed minotaur as a warning of what awaits those who fail.
timeline.quote: That is what awaits us if we fail.

citation.text: Cursed Minotaur (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nissa senses death permeating the plane.
timeline.quote: Death has seeped into every part of this plane.

citation.text: Shadow of the Grave (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds it easy to command the dead on Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: The nature of this plane makes it almost too easy for me to command the dead.

citation.text: Desiccated Naga (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Hours begin when the Second Sun rests between the horns on the horizon.
timeline.quote: When the Second Sun rests between the horns on the horizon, so begins the Hour of Revelation.

citation.text: Throne of the God-Pharaoh (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Pytamun recalls seeing a shadow-dark figure taller than the gods beyond the Hekma as a child.
timeline.quote: shadow-dark, and taller than the gods

citation.text: Grim Strider (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The inhabitants of Amonkhet train all their lives for the Trials of the Five Gods and prepare for the God-Pharaoh's return.
timeline.quote: They train their entire life for a chance to face the Trials of the Five Gods and join the elite ranks of the Worthy

citation.text: "Amonkhet", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch arrives to take out Bolas and meets fierce resistance in the desert and the city.
timeline.quote: When The Gatewatch arrives to take out Bolas, they meet with fierce resistance in the desert

citation.text: "Amonkhet", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas corrupts a pre-existing plane, kills every being old enough to walk, overtakes the gods, seals three away and brainwashes five to steward the plane.
timeline.quote: He sealed three of the gods away, outside the Hekma and left behind five gods to steward the plane until his fateful return.

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "Religion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas engineers a world where inhabitants reach physical perfection before killing each other in the Trials, to create an army of Eternals.
timeline.quote: Bolas's goal was the creation of an army of Zombie warriors known as Eternals

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "Under Bolas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Amonkhet's angels join the God-Pharaoh's hordes in laying waste to the plane during the Hour of Devastation.
timeline.quote: their true loyalty to the God-Pharaoh came to light, as they joined his hordes in laying waste to the plane

citation.text: "Angel", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Basri completes Oketra's Trial of Solidarity, shielding his crop with sand; his spark ignites and he is carried to another plane.
timeline.quote: Basri's latent Planeswalker's spark ignited and he found himself on another plane

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Basri returns to Amonkhet to find it a smoking ruin and Oketra dead.
timeline.quote: Oketra was dead, and everything he had believed turned out to be an elaborate lie.

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After a crisis of faith, Basri rallies the injured and realizes Oketra's teachings still live on.
timeline.quote: He rounded up the injured and weary, encouraged them with what he knew

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Amonkhet the Gatewatch confronts Bolas and is soundly defeated, scattering; Jace is trapped on Ixalan.
timeline.quote: When they confronted the dragon, they were soundly defeated.

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Amonkhet Oketra recognizes Gideon as Kytheon Iora and he pledges himself to her to face the trials.
timeline.quote: pledging himself to her to face the Trials of the Five Gods

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the trial before Bontu, Gideon defies her demand for a heart, and she declares him not a heretic.
timeline.quote: Gideon defied her, to the shock of the crop crowd

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon shields Djeru from Hazoret, who prophesies that he will die by immortal hands.
timeline.quote: Hazoret prophesied to him that he would die by immortal hands

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas defeats the Gatewatch; Gideon is severely wounded, loses his sural and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Gideon was severely wounded, lost his sural, and barely managed to planeswalk away.

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oketra's Trial of Solidarity: a crop must defend its obelisk and retrieve her arrow together.
timeline.quote: The crop had to work together to defend their obelisk and retrieve Oketra's arrow.

citation.text: "God Trials", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kefnet's Trial of Knowledge: initiates must solve a maze of illusion by recognizing the glyph spell that reveals the true exit.
timeline.quote: A vast labyrinth of water and illusion extended before them.

citation.text: "God Trials", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhonas's Trial of Strength: initiates climb thorny vines, lose spellcasting to a toxin and must claim a basilisk's scale for the cure.
timeline.quote: Initiates had to climb thorny vines and ride down a raging waterfall.

citation.text: "God Trials", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bontu's Trial of Ambition: crop members are made to compete and sacrifice each other.
timeline.quote: where they were made to compete rather than cooperate.

citation.text: "God Trials", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hazoret's Trial of Zeal ends with the surviving initiate receiving the most Glorified Death from her forked staff.
timeline.quote: Hazoret granted that initiate the most Glorified Death with her forked staff.

citation.text: "God Trials", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The afterlife promised to the worthy dead is revealed to be transformation into Eternals.
timeline.quote: This "afterlife" was revealed to be the transformation into an Eternal .

citation.text: "God Trials", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Locust God releases a swarm of locusts on an unprepared Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: The Locust God released a swarm of locusts on an unprepared Amonkhet .

citation.text: "Insect", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace helps Liliana kill Razaketh.
timeline.quote: he summoned illusions to distract the demon and allowed Liliana to kill the demon.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas crushes Jace's mind and Jace planeswalks away to avoid mind-death.
timeline.quote: Jace's mind was crushed, and he instinctively planeswalked away to avoid mind-death.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A wurm swallows Liliana on Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: was later swallowed whole by a wurm

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana betrays the Gatewatch and flees Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: Liliana betrayed her friends and fled to another plane

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Most of the gods of Amonkhet die when Bolas returns and ushers in the Hour of Devastation, leaving only Hazoret.
timeline.quote: Most of the gods died when Bolas returned and ushered in the Hour of Devastation, leaving only Hazoret to guide the survivors of Naktamun.

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas imprisons and warps three gods to serve his interests during the Hour of Revelation.
timeline.quote: Three other gods were imprisoned and warped by Bolas to serve his interests during the Hour of Revelation.

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Scorpion God is killed during the Hour of Devastation.
timeline.quote: Killed during the Hour of Devastation.

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Kefnet's trial, Nissa learns to use blue mana.
timeline.quote: Within that trial, she learned not only to trust her instincts but also to utilize her thoughts, making her able to utilize blue mana.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch is defeated by Bolas on Amonkhet; Nissa is saved by Gideon and flees.
timeline.quote: Nissa was mentally overwhelmed by Bolas after she found out that he controlled the leylines of the plane.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Samut watches her friend Nakht wither and die in the desert.
timeline.quote: Samut watched one of her best friends die

citation.text: "Samut", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Varina views a Sol Ring as the third sun of Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: viewed a Sol Ring as the third sun of the plane

citation.text: "Sol Ring", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas curses the Amonkhet sphinxes, banning them from communicating, after his mind control fails against them.
timeline.quote: he placed them under a curse, banning them from communicating with other creatures in any way.

citation.text: "Sphinx", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa Revane contacts Amonkhet's soul and learns it suffers under a terrible curse; it reacts with hostility to her.
timeline.quote: It reacted with hostility to her.

citation.text: "Worldsoul", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sixty years earlier, the dragon arrives from another world with only days of magic left to put his plan in motion.
timeline.quote: He had days.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon builds a throne and a horned monument, and plants a promise of his return in the gods and the people.
timeline.quote: he made a promise to return

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Decades later, the second sun settles between the horns and the dragon comes to collect his hoard.
timeline.quote: The time had come for the dragon to return to collect his hoard.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The story recounts the God-Pharaoh's creation myth, in which he forged five gods and set the Trials and the second sun.
timeline.quote: And so the great God-Pharaoh forged the gods.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The gate to the afterlife opened and the people prostrated themselves in the light of the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: the gate to the afterlife opened, and the people were prostrate in the light of the God-Pharaoh

citation.text: Hour of Revelation (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas taunts Gideon Jura for playing the protector.
timeline.quote: how easy it must be to play the protector when you think yourself untouchable

citation.text: Gideon's Defeat (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas tells Jace he expected disappointment.
timeline.quote: I had hoped for more from you, Jace. But I expected as much.

citation.text: Jace's Defeat (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas tells Liliana he can take away all the power she has gathered.
timeline.quote: All the power you have gathered for yourself, Liliana, I can take away.

citation.text: Liliana's Defeat (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas mocks Chandra's fire.
timeline.quote: Fire? Is that your only trick, Chandra?

citation.text: Chandra's Defeat (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas tells Nissa he would gladly kill the soul of the world again.
timeline.quote: The soul of this world is gone, Nissa, and I would gladly kill it again.

citation.text: Nissa's Defeat (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas declares to the Gatewatch that everything on Amonkhet exists or perishes at his whim.
timeline.quote: Everything here exists or perishes at my whim. Including you, Gatewatch.

citation.text: Hour of Devastation (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas declares his work on Amonkhet complete.
timeline.quote: My work here is complete. The people have done everything required of them.

citation.text: Merciless Eternal (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas declares the plane has outlived its usefulness.
timeline.quote: This place has outlived its usefulness.

citation.text: Doomfall (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jace wonders what Bolas's plan is for the Eternals.
timeline.quote: If creating the Eternals was Bolas's plan here, what is his plan for the Eternals?

citation.text: Eternal of Harsh Truths (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that Bolas remade the plane in his image and holds the advantage.
timeline.quote: Bolas remade this place in his image. He has the advantage here.

citation.text: Strategic Planning (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Djeru loses faith, declaring the God-Pharaoh lied.
timeline.quote: Samut was right. The God-Pharaoh lied.

citation.text: Djeru's Renunciation (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Samut rallies survivors to fight for tomorrow whether they believe the God-Pharaoh tested or betrayed them.
timeline.quote: If you believe he betrayed us all, join with me to fight for tomorrow!

citation.text: Life Goes On (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
